push.title: L 0-4 vs Liquid Cf | You: 6.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.5. Every oak was an acorn that got rained on. Let's grow.

THE GOOD
+ Giveaways 3, down from your usual 6. Proof you've got another gear.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 1. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ 4 goals conceded: +0.2. You did the boring stuff well, and it showed.

THE BAD
- Their best forward posted 8.9 to your 6.5. We can fix that.
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 1. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 2. Here's a thought: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.

THE UGLY
! Passes attempted 8, down from your usual 22. I'm gonna be straight with you: that's not good enough, and you know it. Quick fix: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.

Five-minute drill: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: Nobody remembers the miss. Everybody remembers the response.

Stay curious about your game. - Coach Lasso
